ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels in the distal lobes and 40% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central notch and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) mass extending horizontally, transitioning into high-intensity (white) lobes. High-frequency black-on-white mottling is present at the interface boundaries, with isolated black pixel clusters (spots) distributed at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; approximate interior angle of 38 degrees with significant pixel depth relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the posterior margin; the right lobe exhibits larger, jagged tooth-like peaks, whereas the left lobe features higher-frequency, smaller-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily convex trailing edge trajectory tapering toward the distal tips; trailing edge shows a slight posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete circular low-intensity clusters (dark spots) visible on the white ventral surface near both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal high-intensity (white) linear disruption is visible on the inner right lobe within the black pigment; fine vertical low-intensity striations are visible on the left outer white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal white scar on the lower right interior; irregular tissue loss/notching at the far left tip extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely concentrated 'stippled' pigment pattern at the left-central boundary between black and white regions; unique isolated black 'island' cluster at the extreme right distal tip.
